name: g74_pass_sub_damaged
purpose: Baton Pass with a damaged Substitute (decision 0042, lead requirement): Umbreon (M) raises a Substitute on turn 1; Politoed (M) hits it with Icy Wind on turns 2 to 4 (the speed drop is blocked by the Substitute). On turn 2 Umbreon's second Substitute fails (FAIL EXISTS). On turn 3 Umbreon passes to Ninetales (M), the first standing reserve, which keeps the damaged Substitute. Ninetales' own Substitute fails on turn 4 (EXISTS), and the next Icy Wind breaks the inherited Substitute (the breaking hit shows no -activate).
